specs.value: Power Sand Advance is the current version and replaces Power Sand Basic/Special
Porous natural volcanic rock combined with humus
Bacter 100, Clear Super, Tourmaline BC (bamboo charcoal powder)
Organic nutrients that release slowly plus inorganic nutrients; more nutrient types than Power Sand Basic
S: up to 40 cm; M: 40–60 cm; L: over 60 cm
S: 2 L; M: 6 L; L: 6 L

variants.name: Power Sand Special S/M/L (older version, still sold by some shops)

specs.value: S 2 L, M 6 L, L 18 L
More nutrients than the standard version; contains Bacter 100 and Clear Super

prices.variant: Power Sand M 6 L (page labels it both Advance and Special)

fits.fact: Pick the grain size to match tank height: S for tanks up to 40 cm, M for 40–60 cm, L for taller tanks
Works well under deep-rooted plants such as Cryptocoryne and Echinodorus, and under carpeting foreground plants like Glossostigma and Eleocharis
Not worth using in small tanks or where the substrate is mostly decorative sand
For freshwater planted tanks only, not reef or marine tanks
ADA suggests the standard version over Special when the filter media is new and biological filtration isn't established, because Special can push excess nutrients into the water
Thủy Sinh Tím recommends the 2 L size for tanks under 60 cm and the L size for tanks over 60 cm

usage.fact: Spread it as the bottom layer, either evenly or only where you plan to plant, then cover it with aquasoil such as ADA Amazonia
The soil layer on top should be at least 5 cm thick so the base layer doesn't leak into the water
With Advance, you don't need to add Bacter 100, Clear Super or Tourmaline BC separately because they are already mixed in
The coarse grains leave gaps for water and roots, which keeps the substrate from compacting over time
The inorganic nutrients run out after about 3–6 months; after that, add root tabs such as ADA Multi Bottom or Iron Bottom, pushed deep into the substrate

issues.fact: Power Sand Special has more nutrients, which can leak into the water and make maintenance harder in a new tank
Some shops mix up the Special and Advance names and sizes on the same page (for example, a page titled size M describes size L), so confirm which version you're getting before you buy
Stock is often limited in Vietnam: Greendeal lists every size as out of stock, and Thủy Sinh Tím asks buyers to call and check first
One forum expert argues that Power Sand alone can't support good growth because its CEC is low; this is an opinion, not a measured result
A forum member warns that an overly strong reducing substrate environment can foul the water
One shop notes that genuine ADA bags carry an anti-counterfeit stamp, so check for it when buying
Reviews on Aquasabi are all positive; one buyer said it's hard to tell whether the product is always necessary

alternatives.why: A porous ADA base layer sold in small 1 L packs (450,000 VND), suited to nano tanks or setups that only need a filler and drainage layer
A much cheaper base fertilizer (about 400,000 VND) for small tanks or tight budgets
A low-cost soil (about 280,000 VND) for simple tanks without CO2, where an expensive base layer isn't needed
